tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun las: rin chen mkha' 'gro so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi: rtsa gsum tshe zab cha lag ni: rin chen mkha' 'gro so 'brang ma'i: sgrub thabs don bsdus bstan par bya: dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus: so sor 'brang ma'i sku gzugs bsham: mchod gtor yo byad tshogs par bya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags nas: bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad mchod byin brlabs: chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang: snying rje'i rtsal las hūm̐ yig gis: srung 'khor 'byung lnga ri rab spras: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs lte ba ru: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: praṃ las so sor 'brang ma ni: gser mdog dar dang rin chen brgyan: rin chen 'khor lo zhags pa 'dzin: phyogs bzhir lha mo rigs bzhi yang: dkar ser dmar ljang rang rtags 'dzin: kun kyang zhi ma khro yi nyams: bzhengs stabs zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar: sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbu brgyan zhing: sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi: 'khor yug dpal mgon bdun cur bcas: kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐: thugs srog las ni 'od 'phros pas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos dbyings zhing khams nas: sems ma so sor 'brang ma ni: byang chub sems ma'i tshogs dang bcas: thugs dam bzhin du gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: lha mo 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras mo mchog: khyod la dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na ma mi: hūm̐: rnam lnga la sogs phyi yi mchod pa dang: sman rag gtor ma nang gi mchod pa'i sprin: ye shes sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: de bzhin gshegs ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza ho: pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ta na gha ṇa pū dza ho:

hūm̐: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mo mchog: 'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras du mar sprul: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dngos grub mchog stsol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar zla steng praṃ yig la: sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: rgyal mchod byin rlabs thams cad bsdus: 'gro ba'i don byas snod bcud kun: lha sngags ye shes ngang du bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi dhā ri badz+ri ṇī ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ phaṭa: 'bum phrag bdun bzlas dngos grub 'grub: de nas mchod bstod gsol ba gdab: snang srid 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdag nyid dmigs med klong du bzhag: slar yang lhar bsgom smon lam bya: sa ma ya: slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni: dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing sgrub mchod bya: slob mas yon 'bul gsol ba btab: rgyud sbyang byin rlabs brtan par bya: hūm̐: bum pa bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang: so sor 'brang ma'i lha tshogs bzhugs: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: slob ma'i sgrib pa dag gyur cig: sngags mthar: ka la shaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ā: bla ma so sor 'brang ma yum: dga' bzhir rol pa'i byang chub sems: skal ldan lce la bzhag pa yis: bde chen gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: sngags mthar: gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: slob ma rin chen dpa' bo dang: so sor 'brang ma mnyam sbyor bas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs nas su: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: sngags mthar: ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med par: zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes ni: rdul bral ye nas rnam par dag: mtha' dang bral ba'i don rtogs shog: sngags mthar: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes kyi rim pa spyi ltar bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: nor rnams ma lus 'byung ba'i gter: bu yi dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir: sbyin gtong tshogs gsag rgyas par bya: dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bris pa'i dbus:

rin chen bum pa rgyun 'bab chu: bo dhi tsit+ta'i 'bras bu ni: mig med brdungs pa'i phye ma dang: lnga phrag lnga dang bdud rtsis bkang: 'bras bu can gyi shing dang ni: dar gyi mgul chings sogs kyis brgyan: mchod pa rgyas par bshams nas su: bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang: bdud rtsi'i steng du pad zla'i dbus: lha bskyed spyan drangs mchod bstod bya: thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las: 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros: sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras rnams dang: bar do'i rnam shes skal bzang rnams: bkug nas thig le nṛs mtshan pas: bum pa'i nang rnams gang bar bsam: sngags kyi tha mar sham bu ni: pu tra sid+dhi sid+dhi hūm̐: shing thog 'bras bu rnyed pa dang: lha mos bu ster rmis pa sogs: rtags ni ma byung bar du bsgrub: bum lha la ni mchod bstod bya: 'od zhu bdud rtsir gyur pa yis: bu spel nus pa ldan par bsam: snga ma'i rdzas kyi phye ma dang: bum chu sbyar te ril bu bya: bsgrub bya rdul 'dzags zhag gsum lon: khrus byas bgegs bskrad lha ru bsgom: ril bu sbyin zhing yun brten na: bu yi dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur: tha tshom med pas don 'grub bo: 'di ltar las tshogs byas pa yi: bu de rigs bzang blo dang ldan: bsod nams che bas nor rnams 'byung: de bas gdams pa shin tu zab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rtsa gsum tshe'i zab pa'i cha lag mchog gyur gling pa'i zab gter ro/// /
